scope: First-day guide manual flow review and static comparison to actual starter/completion files. No installation, model, DB or student rehearsal.
findings_fixed: Do not request server startup from code-free starter before implementation.
Place generated-file readiness and build/serve sequence after first creation action.
Separate coding assistant from service model and configure the latter at first natural-language question.
Use actual source paths and existing synthetic graph IDs; first-day graph is CSV-based.
Do not require an intentionally wrong answer before dictionary comparison.
timing: Added guidance is included within planned blocks; actual student time remains unmeasured.
